svg.desc: 17,506 GitHub contributions across 153 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-29. The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.
svg.text: ORE FACETS: 1 QUARTZ / 3 COPPER / 10 GOLD / 30 DIAMOND
